description: Get a one-time URL to upload a local video or audio file (mp4, mov, webm, mkv, mp3, wav, m4a...) up to 2 GB. Upload with HTTP PUT of the raw bytes, e.g. `curl -T video.mp4 "<upload_url>"` (valid 15 minutes), then pass `public_url` to transcribe_media or localize_video. Only files uploaded here (or on ttsforfree.com) are accepted; YouTube and other external links are never downloaded. If you cannot run commands, ask the user to upload the file on https://ttsforfree.com/en/video-localization/ and paste the file link.

file_name.description: Original file name with extension, e.g. lesson-01.mp4

name: create_upload_url
title: Upload a video/audio file
